request: Pull the HIFLD Military_Installation FeatureServer (public geoplatform.gov copy of the DoD Base Structure Report footprint — 744 US + overseas sites with polygon footprints, COMPONENT, JOINT_BASE, STATE_TERR/COUNTRY, and reported AREA in acres). Enrich each site with a replacement_likelihood_score computed from its acreage, joint-basing status, service component, and overseas/SOFA exposure. Output a local Hyper extract for analyst use; not published to Server (local-only demo run).

sources.name: HIFLD Military Installations
sources.description: HIFLD (Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data) Military_Installation FeatureServer hosted at geoplatform.gov. Polygon layer, one row per installation. Attributes: SITE_NAME, COMPONENT (Army/Air Force/Marine Corps/Navy/Coast Guard/etc), JOINT_BASE (name of joint base or 'N/A'), STATE_TERR, COUNTRY, OPER_STAT (open/closed), AREA (acres), IS_FIRRMA. 744 records as of query time.

outputs.name: DoD Critical Infrastructure (Replacement Likelihood)
outputs.description: One row per DoD installation from HIFLD Military_Installation, enriched with criticality_score and replacement_likelihood_score. Scoring weights: AREA (log-scaled) 40, JOINT_BASE flag 25, COMPONENT strategic weight 20, overseas flag 15. Columns: SITE_NAME, COMPONENT, JOINT_BASE, STATE_TERR, COUNTRY, OPER_STAT, AREA (km^2), IS_FIRRMA, criticality_score, replacement_likelihood_score.
